source_sample: Knabel et al. spatially resolved KCWI kinematics of 14 SLACS lenses

selection_facts_used: spatial-bin systematics and covariance are quantified
the sample has existing HST strong-lens imaging by construction
forbidden_selection_facts: a candidate's fit quality under the proposed negative-gravity idea

candidate_level_gate.accepted_dynamics_support_must_reach_arc: the full detected HST arc radial span for that candidate

screening_order: extract all 14 sample identities, coordinates, redshifts, KCWI programs, exposure times, seeing, spatial bins, accepted radial support, and covariance statements from the exact primary source
extract each system's HST filter/program, published Einstein radius or arc span, source redshift, and public lens-model or likelihood reference from primary SLACS sources
query KOA and MAST metadata without downloading science arrays
rank candidates only by common radial support, released observable products, and nuisance-model rerunnability
freeze one or more exact acquisition/Jacobian protocols only for candidates passing every metadata gate

sample_outcomes.advance: At least one of the 14 lenses passes every pre-pixel gate and has a source/lens product that prevents the E325 coordinate-map boundary failure from being rediscovered only after data download.
sample_outcomes.partial: Retain any public numerical KCWI maps as dynamics controls, but do not download HST arrays for systems whose lens likelihood or common support is not established.
sample_outcomes.fail: If none pass, publish a 14-row hard-shortfall ledger and move to RXJ1131-1231 or another named released-likelihood sample without weakening the gate.

progress_checkpoint.time_box: one exact primary-source extraction and archive-metadata cycle for all 14 lenses
progress_checkpoint.rethink_after: three consecutive external candidates/source classes with zero structural promotion; J0946 and E325 currently count as two
